dataset_name: Organization-Specific .NET Web API Controlled Test Set - 4 Categories

design.ground_truth_visibility: Evaluator only; never send ground_truth to LLM Only or LLM+RAG.
design.purpose: Compare LLM Only and LLM+RAG on organization-specific standards using balanced positive and negative cases.
design.evaluation_mode: controlled paired test: one target rule per FAIL/PASS pair
design.source_code_format: Full standalone C# source fixture suitable for GitHub PR review; each case includes surrounding declarations/context.

coding_standards.title: Variable and Parameter Naming - camelCase
coding_standards.description: Local variables and method parameters must use camelCase.

coding_standards.title: Async Method Naming - Async Suffix
coding_standards.description: Methods returning Task/Task<T> must end with Async.

coding_standards.title: Type and Method Naming - PascalCase
coding_standards.description: Class/type and method names must use PascalCase.

coding_standards.title: Exception Handling - Empty Catch Prohibited
coding_standards.description: Exceptions must not be silently swallowed by an empty catch block; handle, log, translate, or rethrow them according to the organization exception policy.
